thread:
Alex: hi everyone  started today on Eng-Platform. trying to compile a tiny "who to ping" list for week 0: i need badge access, gcp project permissions for dev, a walkthrough of the model-serving playbook, and who to page if a Dedicated customer has an SLA alert. can folks call out owners?

access-bot: welcome @Alex! New-hire starter: https://redwood.internal/newhire-start. To request access, run `#access-request` or the form: https://redwood.internal/forms/access-request.

Jordan: welcome Alex :wave: short guide: badge -> facilities (cc people-ops), dev GCP -> `#eng-infra` and put `eng-infra` as approver on the form, prod/service accounts -> request in `#eng-sre-access` and tag @Rina.

Rina: adding: I own production IAM approvals and service-account scoping. For Dedicated customer entitlement grants, ping @Carlos (solutions) and include the customer org-id and SLA tier.

Carlos: yup, Dedicated handoffs go through `#solutions-onboarding`. For urgent SLA alerts, notify `@support-oncall` and escalate to `#support-escalations` with a short incident summary. Also include `incident_id` and customer name so we can correlate.

Alex: thanks! is there a tiny triage ladder for runtime vs infra vs customer support? want to avoid cross-posting during a pager.

Jordan: good q. Ladder we use: 1) runtime errors (latency/serving) -> `#eng-runtime` then `@eng-runtime-oncall`. 2) infra provisioning/perm failures -> `#eng-infra` then `@eng-infra-oncall`. 3) customer impact/SLAs -> `#support-escalations` then `@support-leads`. If multiple domains affected, start in `#incident-coord`.

Rina: also note: for Dedicated incidents that might need Dedicated infra (reserved GPUs) tag `@dedicated-ops` and include `gpu-pool-id` and `model` in the ticket.

Alex: where's the runbook link? want to skim before a possible walkthrough.

Jordan: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-serving.md. It has a "first 10min" checklist and quick rollback steps.

facilities-bot: Badge request received for Alex. ETA 2 business days unless People Ops flags urgent. Reference: ticket #FAC-4521.

Alex: perfect. last thing  who can approve temporary VPN for contractor-style access (short lived)?

Rina: eng-infra handles short-lived VPN tokens, but we need an approver on the form. For contractor access request set expiry and cc your manager + `@eng-infra`. If you hit a delay, ping @Rina and I'll escalate.

Carlos: I'll add a brief "who-to-cc" table to the new-hire doc later today: Access, Badge, Prod IAM, Dedicated grants, Oncall. will paste here when done.

Alex: thanks all, super helpful. i'll start the forms now and DM if anything fails. :raised_hands:
